caveats: Sea cells = 3310 of 3600 region grid cells with finite SST on all 92 target days; land cells are 0. Threshold/climatology pools per the specified method also include the 10 edge-extension days 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05; all 4028 window days were present (no missing files). SST is stored as float32 kelvin; all computations in float64. Per-cell MHW detection uses only 2005-06-01..2005-08-31, so a run straddling the period start would be measured from 2005-06-01 (earliest detected onset here was 2005-07-02, so no such truncation occurred).
